description: This file defines an abstract service class for managing leave allocations in an HRM system. It includes methods for handling overlapping leaves, validating leave application rules, calculating leave durations, and creating leave request objects. It heavily relies on traits for auxiliary functionalities like date handling, logging, and employee management.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveAllocationService
classes.description: An abstract service class that provides core functionalities for managing leave allocations, including overlap detection, duration calculations, and leave request creation for the HRM system.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to save a leave request and send notifications, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Abstract method to determine the status of a leave request based on conditions like weekends and holidays.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Abstract method to decide if leave can exceed the user's balance.

methods.name: getHashKeyForLeaveParamObject
methods.description: Generates a unique hash key for a leave parameter object to use as a cache key.

methods.name: getOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves leaves overlapping with the given leave parameters, utilizing cached results for efficiency.

methods.name: hasOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Checks if there are any overlapping leaves with the given parameters.

methods.name: isEmployeeAllowedToApply
methods.description: Determines if an employee is permitted to apply for a given leave type. Currently always returns true.

methods.name: isWorkShiftLengthExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the total leave hours for a day exceed the employee's work shift length.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLengthExceedOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Returns list of leave requests that exceed work shift length for the specified leave parameters.

methods.name: generateLeaveRequest
methods.description: Creates a new LeaveRequest object initialized with leave parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDurationForEmployee
methods.description: Fetches the work shift length for a specific employee.

methods.name: getApplicableLeaveDuration
methods.description: Determines the appropriate leave duration based on whether it's the first or last day of a multi-day leave.

methods.name: updateLeaveDurationParameters
methods.description: Updates leave object start/end times and duration hours based on leave type, day type, and schedule.

methods.name: addHoursDuration
methods.description: Adds specified hours to a given DateTime object, returning the resulting DateTime.

methods.name: getDurationInHours
methods.description: Calculates the difference in hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: createLeaveObjectListForAppliedRange
methods.description: Creates a list of leave objects for each day in the applied leave range, considering weekends, holidays, and partial days.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a given day is marked as a half-day in the employee's schedule.

methods.name: isWeekend
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a weekend according to the employee's schedule.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfdayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is considered a half-day holiday.
